scope: Exactly the 3772 archived ICRS direction records: 943 source coordinate pairs and three mirrors each; do not include 320 unrelated arbitrary scalar projections in this coordinate collapse. Do not add a fabricated sky observation.
geometry: Compute unit-vector sum of all 3772 directions. If nonzero, report spherical resultant RA/Dec and normalized length. The RA reflection/equator/antipode quartet breaks rotational symmetry and can force equator/RA-axis degeneracy; this geometric resultant is not presumed physical.

fingerprint_collapse.normalization: For each of 3772 records take fields ra_deg and dec_deg formatted as fixed 12 digits after decimal, plus operator verbatim. Form CSV line 'ra,dec,operator'; lexicographically sort all 3772 lines including duplicates; concatenate as UTF-8 with a terminal newline. No source path or file order included.
fingerprint_collapse.digest: SHA-256 over domain_separator ASCII followed by canonical sorted coordinate lines
fingerprint_collapse.direction: Interpret digest bytes[0:8] and bytes[8:16] as unsigned big-endian 64-bit integers; ra_deg=360*u0/2**64; dec_deg=asin(2*u1/2**64-1) in degrees. This yields a uniform-sphere, pseudorandom fingerprint direction. It is mathematically deterministic, NOT an astronomical estimator or prediction.

preregistered_catalog.target: singularity fingerprint and geometric resultant separately
preregistered_catalog.service: SIMBAD TAP independently query after digest freeze
preregistered_catalog.controls: 256 independent uniform-sphere random directions via SHA256(domain_separator + digest_hex + ':control:' + i), same 30 arcsec cone; report background rate and no significance if unavailable. Additionally repeat on mirrored fingerprint as negative-control exploratory directions only.
preregistered_catalog.repeatability: Propose Gaia+WISE independent epochs/instruments only if both datasets permit unambiguous source matching; existing external telescope pointing still HOLD.
preregistered_catalog.significance: A catalog neighbor is not unknown or anomalous; no claim without documented independent measurements, multiplicity and selection controls.

output: research artifacts + GitHub Meta Registry JSON manifest; production models unchanged
limitations: A cryptographic hash of coordinates generates a uniform random sky position by design; no reason to expect a probe at that location. The spherical mean of mirrored points may be a symmetry artifact.
